chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from both of them together, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from 'Ammar ibn Marwan, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, there was for Allah a Messenger who was a Prophet, upon whom his people gained power, so they skinned the skin of his face and the fur (scalp) of his head. Then a Messenger came to him from the Lord of the Worlds and said to him: Your Lord conveys His greetings to you and says, 'I have seen what was done to you,' and He has ordered me to obey you, so order me to do whatever you wish. He replied, 'I will take the example of al-Husain (peace be upon him).'
ai.seo_question: Which Prophet is referred to in the hadith as having his face and scalp skinned, and what was his response regarding Imam Husain?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this Prophet is widely identified as Prophet Zakariyya (Zechariah), whose martyrdom by skinning is recorded in multiple sources, establishing a direct typological link between his sacrifice and that of Imam al-Husain. The angel’s command to obey the Prophet signifies the continuity of divine authority, while the Prophet’s choice of Husain as his 'uswa' (model) elevates the Ahl al-Bayt’s suffering to a universal prophetic standard. This narration underscores the theological concept that the martyrdom of the Imams is not an isolated event but a continuation of the prophetic legacy of sacrifice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, and Ya’qūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ‘Ammār ibn Marwān, from Samā’ah ibn Mihrān, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

The nation of one of Allāh’s prophets, who was (also) a messenger, overpowered him. They skinned his face and his scalp. A messenger (an angel) from the Lord of the Worlds came to him and said: Your Lord conveys His Salām to you and says, “I see what they are doing to you.” And He has ordered me to obey you. Therefore, order me to do that which you want (to this nation). He replied, “I follow the example of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
